fields.label: Owner Node
fields.description: The Consolidation Group node that holds this share: an entity node or a group node of the same hierarchy. Pre-filled with the owned node's tree parent when left blank (the one default); change it when another member holds the share.

fields.label: Consolidation Group
fields.description: With Entity, names the Consolidation Group node this period describes (the owned node).

fields.label: Entity
fields.description: The owned node, with Consolidation Group. Blank for a group node: an Ownership Period says how much of THIS node its Owner Node holds.

fields.label: Owner Group
fields.description: The owner node's group code, resolved from Owner Node on every save; synced to the warehouse.

fields.label: Owner Entity
fields.description: The owner node's entity, resolved from Owner Node on every save; blank when a group node holds the share. Synced to the warehouse.

fields.label: Owner Label
fields.description: The owner's entity code, else its group code; set before naming so a new period is named OP-{owner}-{owned}-{date} (the controller's autoname; the owned label is the entity code, else the group code).

fields.label: Supersedes
fields.description: The period this change ends on approval.

fields.label: Superseded End Date
fields.description: The superseded period's end date before approval, which a cancel restores. Blank means open-ended.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: Blank means the period is still open. (It used to default to 9999-12-31, which ClickHouse's Date type cannot hold and silently clamped.)

fields.label: Acquisition Date
fields.description: Set by the Business Combination / Business Disposal that created this period.

fields.label: First Acquisition
fields.description: Set by the Business Combination / Business Disposal that created this period.

fields.label: Acquisition Price
fields.description: Set by the Business Combination / Business Disposal that created this period.

fields.label: Fair Value Adjustment
fields.description: Set by the Business Combination / Business Disposal that created this period.

fields.label: Is Disposal
fields.description: Set by the Business Disposal that closed this period.

fields.label: Disposal Date
fields.description: Set by the Business Disposal that closed this period.

fields.label: Disposal Price
fields.description: Set by the Business Disposal that closed this period.
